params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $dest=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-bridge-main-verify-latest'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Recurse -Force}; git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $dest; $clone=$LASTEXITCODE; if($clone -ne 0){exit $clone}; $sha=(git -C $dest rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output ('MAIN_SHA='+$sha); Push-Location $dest; try { powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '.\heaven-bridge\manage.ps1' TEST; $test=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('BRIDGE_TEST_EXIT='+$test) } finally { Pop-Location }; git -C $dest diff --check; $diff=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('DIFF_CHECK_EXIT='+$diff); if(($test -ne 0)-or($diff -ne 0)){exit 1}; Write-Output 'EXACT_MAIN_BRIDGE_GATE_PASS'
